title: Minimum Number of Moves to Make Palindrome
summary: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, determine the least number of adjacent swaps required to transform s into a palindrome.
statement: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, determine the least number of adjacent swaps required to transform s into a palindrome. The string can always be converted into a palindrome as per the input conditions.
constraints: The lowercase string is guaranteed to be rearrangeable into a palindrome.
One move swaps two adjacent characters.
Return the minimum number of moves, not the resulting palindrome.
hints: Fix mirrored positions from the outside inward.
Find the rightmost match for the left character and bubble it to the right boundary; if none exists, move the odd singleton one step toward the center.
Repeat until pointers meet, counting each adjacent swap.
Using the nearest right-side match minimizes swaps for the fixed outer position; an unmatched character must be the unique odd-frequency center and every step toward center is necessary.
editorial: Using the nearest right-side match minimizes swaps for the fixed outer position; an unmatched character must be the unique odd-frequency center and every step toward center is necessary.

tests.explanation: Bubble the matching a and b characters into mirrored positions using two adjacent swaps.
Greedily matching the outer letters requires two adjacent swaps in total.
